name: graffish-labs
description: Small Claude Code plugins from Graffish Labs: some inspired by graffy, others that complement it.

plugins.name: connect
plugins.description: Signs you in to Graffish vigil once and stores your personal token in every installed graffish-labs plugin.

plugins.name: support
plugins.description: Support tickets for team members and clients who don't run graffy, with a dashboard pane.

plugins.name: telemetry
plugins.description: Sends Claude Code session-start and tool-use events from hooks to Graffish vigil (Loki + Prometheus).
